blurb: Kickapoo Adventures offers bike rentals, paddling rentals including canoes, kayaks, SUPs, pedal boats, and electric GoBoats on lakes and the Middle Fork River. They provide shuttle services for river trips and personal boats. Rentals include necessary gear like PFDs and paddles, and guests are advised on safety and trip completion times.
extraNote: Reservations required and payment due at time of booking · Arrive 30 minutes prior to departure · All rentals and trips must be completed by 5:00 pm except for later start times · No glass or styrofoam allowed on river trips · Late or lost parties may be subject to additional search party charges · No walk-ups allowed if trips are at capacity · Kickapoo Adventures shop located on Clear Lake, Kickapoo State Park
